title: Discord Logs
body:
**Discord Logs Plugin**

Want to keep your Minecraft server fully synchronized with Discord? The Discord Logs Plugin makes it easy!
All chats, events, and moderation actions are automatically sent to your Discord server in real time. Perfect for admins and community managers who need full visibility.

**Features**

**Chat Logging:** Every message is mirrored in Discord.

**Event Logging:** Player joins, leaves, deaths, achievements – automatically recorded.

**Moderation Logging:** Bans, kicks, mutes, and warnings are instantly logged.

**Configurable Channels:** 
Direct different events to specific Discord channels.

**Webhook Support:** Simple setup via Discord Webhooks. No complex API needed.

**Performance Friendly:** Optimized to run smoothly without lag.
Customizable: Fully configurable via a friendly config file.

Supported Versions:
Minecraft: 1.21.x (Paper & Spigot)
Java: 21

**Setup in 3 Easy Steps:**
Create a Discord webhook.
Insert it into the plugin config.

Restart your server and enjoy live logs.

Why Choose This Plugin?
Keep your moderation team updated in real-time.

Make your community safer and more transparent.
Never miss a key server event, even when you’re away.

ℹ️The log system has been modified to only display important logs.ℹ️
